subject: Prioritizing demo scope and assigning security/evidence owners
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Sara Wong <sara.wong@atlasretail.com>; Daniel Brooks <daniel.brooks@atlasretail.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + proposal for next steps

Hi Sara / Daniel —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Short recap and concrete next steps so we can keep momentum: 

1) Scope: Atlas is most interested in (a) low-latency search reranking for product pages and (b) a lightweight personalization hook for marketing banners. We agreed the initial demo should focus on the reranking flow end-to-end (query -> embeddings -> rerank) and show cost/latency tradeoffs.

2) Stakeholders to loop: you mentioned security and procurement. Can you please share the right contacts for evidence and network intake? If it helps, we usually hand off SOC2 + logging questions to our security lead and procurement/legal to our contracts team.

3) Demo logistics: proposed windows next week — Tue 3/23 10:00–11:00 PT or Thu 3/25 14:00–15:00 PT. We can do a 45–60 minute technical deep dive with time for Q&A.

4) Deliverables before demo: a short agenda + checklist of evidence items we’ll bring (SOC2 summary, example retention policy, network egress notes). I’ll attach a first-pass agenda.

If those two time windows look reasonable, I’ll lock one and loop in our security lead (Marissa) and platform engineer (Karthik) so they can handle the evidence/SSO questions live.

Thanks — talk soon,

Olga Petrov
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com | (415) 555-0142
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_Demo_Agenda_v1.pdf (1 page agenda)
From: Sara Wong <sara.wong@atlasretail.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Brooks <daniel.brooks@atlasretail.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + proposal for next steps

Hi Olga —

Thanks for the clear recap. Both time windows look possible; leaning toward Thu 3/25 14:00 PT so more of our engineering team can join. 

Security/procurement contacts below:
- Maya Singh (security SME) — maya.singh@atlasretail.com
- Priya Rao (procurement) — priya.rao@atlasretail.com (cc’d on procurement requests normally, but not included on this thread yet)

Two quick asks from our side before we lock: 
- Can you confirm what evidence you’ll have on hand during the call (SOC2 scope, access logs, PII handling notes)?
- Do you have a short network diagram or egress requirements we can pre-check with our infra team?

If you can loop in your security/ops owner and the final agenda, I’ll confirm Thu 3/25 14:00 PT and add calendar invites internally.

—Sara
Sara Wong
Director, Product Operations | Atlas Retail
sara.wong@atlasretail.com | (628) 555-0199

Hi all —

Thanks for the loop, Olga. I can join Thu 3/25 14:00 PT. Quick note on artifacts and ownership so expectations are clear: 

• What I’ll present live: SOC2 scope summary (control families we cover), logging/alerting summary, and the short retention policy that applies to production logs.
• What Karthik will present live: architecture diagram focused on egress, VPC peering options, and SSO flow for platform integration.
• What we’ll upload in advance: a one-page SOC2 summary (attached), a short network diagram (PNG), and the procurement template that Atlas can pre-fill.

From Atlas I’ll need an evidence owner for the logging/retention questions (who can confirm retention policies and SIEM intake) — Sara / Maya, can you confirm who on your infra team will be available? If they can drop items into the procurement template we’ll use that as the checklist during the call.

I attached the SOC2-summary.pdf and the Procurement_Template_Atlas.docx stub (so your procurement team has the format).

Marissa Cole
Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

See you Thu — I’ll accept the calendar invite once you send it.

Sara
